content: अध्रुव {%a.%} .²1 Uncertain, doubtful. .²2 Unsteady, moving, not fixed or permanent; स्वाङ्गेऽध्रुवे <ls>P. III. 4. 54</ls>; separable (which can be severed or detached without fatal or disastrous effects) (येन विना न जीवनं सोऽध्रुवः <ls>Sk.</ls>) .{@-वम्@} An uncertainty; यो ध्रुवाणि परित्यज्य अध्रुवाणि निषेवते . ध्रुवाणि तस्य नश्यन्ति अध्रुवं नष्टमेव च <ls>H. 1. 184</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> the <lang>English</lang> phrase ‘A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush’.
